goal: Implement injectable production OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-compatible, and Gemini-native Android generation runtimes without making real network calls in tests.
non_goals: Do not modify Compose, Room, Python APIs, or application wiring.
Do not place API keys in domain models, logs, test fixtures, or error messages.
Do not remove FakeLlmGenerationRuntime from deterministic tests.
acceptance_criteria: A composite runtime routes all three supported protocols.
Secrets are resolved only at execution time from secretRef.
Streaming and non-streaming provider responses are parsed.
Provider status and protocol failures map to retryable safe results.
Tests use a fake transport and perform zero real network calls.
verification_expectations: Report required Gradle dependencies without editing controller-owned settings.
